purpose: Internal exploratory comparison only; not a formal acceptance test.
metric_protocol: Full 512x512 COMPLEX field. Original evaluation alignment: amplitude COM, MAE-selected direct/conjugate-twin, global phase fitted on the reference amplitude>=0.3 support. Each field is whole-image RMS normalized; BOTH are then divided by the same aligned-reference peak modulus. MAE=mean(abs(pred-reference)); MSE=mean(abs(pred-reference)**2); PSNR=-10*log10(MSE), peak modulus=1. No scoring crop/mask, no clipping, and no real/imaginary-channel averaging. Local phase errors count.
timing_scope: System timing starts after the sample has been read, transferred CPU-to-device, and preprocessed. It includes model inference and copying the final complex array to CPU memory. It excludes model loading, file reading, transfer, preprocessing, truth alignment, scoring and disk writes.
traditional_algorithm: Random-start complex HIO + terminal ER, adaptive shrinkwrap; no positivity constraint.
hio_parameter_source_and_deviations: Marchesini et al. (2003): beta=0.9, initial autocorrelation contour=4%, shrinkwrap every 20 iterations, threshold=20% of blurred amplitude maximum, Gaussian sigma=3 px reduced by 1% per update to 1.5 px. Project-fixed settings not specified by that paper: 1500 HIO iterations, 100 terminal ER iterations, four random starts, and stopping support updates at iteration 1200.
seed_rule: global seed + zero-based sample display order
